description: Land Acquisition - Dimbulamure, Wellawaya, Yalabowa, Wellawaya D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project. It contains detailed descriptions of 48 land allotments with their boundaries, extents, and claimants. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition for a development project) without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4).
